subject.title: fix(plugins): surface oversized-file warnings in doctor migration reads

question: May `openclaw doctor` intentionally skip valid legacy plugin state above 10 MiB, or must it preserve/migrate that state through an explicit recovery contract?
rationale: The PR introduces a new persisted-state migration ceiling across three plugins; choosing between data preservation, operator recovery, and an intentional skip is product and upgrade policy rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Preserve oversized-state recovery
options.body: Keep the bounded descriptor read but add a supported recovery or migration path so existing state is not silently left behind.

options.title: Accept warning-only skip
options.body: Approve the 10 MiB cap as the permanent migration contract and document actionable remediation for users whose state is not migrated.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer the cap until maintainers define a shared doctor migration policy for oversized persisted state.

recommendation.title: Preserve oversized-state recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded descriptor read but add a supported recovery or migration path so existing state is not silently left behind.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the three plugin-owned doctor migration contracts affected by this branch.
